Title: SpaceX Starship Flight 12 live launch updates: 1st Starship V3 launch scrubbed at last minute - Space
Summary:
Here's a summary of the news article in 3 concise bullet points:

*   SpaceX's first launch attempt for its new Starship V3 megarocket was scrubbed at the last minute.
*   The company has rescheduled the launch for Friday, May 22.
*   This mission marks the inaugural flight of the Starship V3, SpaceX's newest Starship design.

Title: Trump says he’ll ‘try’ to attend son’s wedding this weekend but it’s ‘not good timing’ - NBC News
Summary:
